comments.body: issue (high): 🟠 **Phase 6 makes Full review the diff twice** **(blocking)** Full already ran `review-loop` in Step 3, and `aw-executor` sends it here. This line forbids `--no-pre-review`, and line 74 says call `create-pr` bare, so Step 5.5 reviews the diff again. ```markdown **Invoke it with the tier's flags from [`aw` § Review](../aw/SKILL.md#review) — never scale it down further by default:** - Lite: `Skill("create-pr", "--no-post-review")` - Full: `Skill("create-pr", "--no-pre-review --no-post-review")` (Step 3 already reviewed) `--pr-review` drops only `--no-post-review`. ``` _Pseudo-code — verify before applying._ `pr-reviewer` · commit `5f24968`

issue (medium): 🟡 **Full's receipt forces a second local review** **(non-blocking)** On Full, `aw` passes `--no-pre-review`, so these lines read `skipped`. Line 177 admits only user-passed flags, and line 196 then orders the skipped pass run: a second review. ```markdown - aw Step 3 → local review-loop (Full only): )> - create-pr → local review-loop (branch-reviewer pass): )> ``` _Pseudo-code — verify before applying._ `pr-reviewer` · commit `5f24968`

suggestion (low): ⚪ **Micro row still calls create-pr bare** **(non-blocking)** The Review table gives Micro `create-pr --no-post-review`, but this row ends in bare `create-pr`, which runs the posted Step 6.5 loop. ```markdown | **Micro** | You, single-pass: Phase 0 quick confirm → Phase 2 worktree → edit → fast check → `docs update` only on drift → `create-pr --no-post-review` ([Review](#review)) | in-conversation brief | none (docs if needed) | ``` `pr-reviewer` · commit `5f24968`
